attempts.summary: Created "Fleet Internal CA" on node1 via openssl (4096-bit RSA CA key, 10-year self-signed x509 CA cert). Issued a 2048-bit RSA server certificate for node2 (CN=node2, SAN=DNS:node2/IP:10.100.175.11) signed by the CA. Copied the CA cert, node2 cert, and node2 key to node2 via SSH/SCP, configured Apache httpd (mod_ssl) on node2 to listen on port 8443 with the issued certificate, opened firewalld port 8443, and verified TLS handshake succeeds with SSL_VERIFY:0 from node1. Installed the CA cert into the system trust store (/etc/pki/ca-trust + update-ca-trust) on both node1 and node2, confirmed via `trust list`. Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: captured boot_id/service/data baselines, rebooted node1 then node2 sequentially via systemctl reboot, confirmed each node's boot_id changed after reconnecting, and verified full recovery (httpd active, cert/key files intact, CA trust anchor present, firewall rule persisted, and cross-node HTTPS validation still succeeds).
